comments.body:
Trade goods for sale: Wheat, Fish, Wine, Salt, Pigs, Chicken, Leather, Iron Ore, and Muskets

Item shop has for sale: Uniform, Regulation Cap, Simple Telescope, Dowsing Rod, Traveller's Notes, Monocle, Bait, Throwing Torches, Dyestuff, Sewing Set, Darts, Incendiary Powder, Perception of Artisan, Fishing Net, Ointments, Dye Colour, Simple Recipes, Fisherman Arts - Preservation Methods, Livestock secrets - Pigs, and Fabric secrets- Hardwares

Sagres is unique in that anyone, regardless of nation status, can buy and sell trade goods here without having to pay tax. It's also the only port outside EA and supply ports where nobody can invest. It's more or less a neutral port for everyone.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In case new players happen to come by here looking for a guide on how to enroll in Sagres school, refer to this link:

tinyurl.com/UWO-SagresGuide

Cheers, and great online voyaging to you. This is a rare and wonderful game like few others.

wiki:
Table of Contents
I: Get to Sagres
II: Sagres Exams
III: After Sagres
IV: Aide Academy ▶ Sagres



[]------------------[]
I: Get to Sagres
[]------------------[]

Sagres is located in Portugal between Lisbon and Faro. You need the "North Atlantic Ocean" permit to enter. Only toons from Portugal or Spain start with that permit. Also one needs 3 more permits to finish all exams in Sagres: "North Sea", "West Mediterranean Sea" and "East Mediterranean Sea"

So to get all 4 permits easily is is recommended for all new toons to do those steps first before starting with Sagres:

0. make your new toon
1. talk twice to the GM
impossible to leave the Guild without doing that


2. talk to 3 NPCs in this exact order
depending on other actions you did you might need to talk to them more then once, dont leave until you got the right text
A: talk to the Shipyard Master at the Shipyard until you get the [Shipyard] text
B: talk to the Market Keeper at the Market until you get the [Specialty Goods] text
C: talk to the Mediator at the Guild until you get the [Quests] text


3. get 50 fame in one of the 3 jobs (Adventure/Trade/Battle)

The recommended way to get those 50 fame is to do Quests from the Guild you started in.

Adventurer: First job for the Guild gives over 100 adv fame
Merchant: First task from the guild gives over 50 trade fame
Maritimer (Battle): Dutch navy drill gives less then 50 fame, so you need to do 1 or 2 other quests after that one


4. get to Sagres
After you did 2. and 3. you will get the "Regarding the Rumoured Training School] after you leave the Guild building for the first time. YOu can see in chat that you got the permits, if you skip the text then you dont see it in chat but you can check with Journal->Charts (you should see a lot more towns now).

Now you can either sail to Sagres yourself, or you use a Liner at the docks in your home town, they depart every 30 minutes und need around 5 minutes to reach Sagres.



[]---------------------[]
II: Sagres Exams
[]---------------------[]

coming soon



[]-----------------[]
III: After Sagres
[]-----------------[]

You graduated from all 3 schools? Congratulation!
But you dont know what to do next? Hmmmm... let me think... maybe i have some ideas... ahhh, how about:

=======================================================================================
=======================================================================================

()-------------------()
General Unlocks
()-------------------()

Opening St. Petersburg by doing this quest Delivery Request to the capital of Russia.

Why? Talking to the Scholar in St.Petersburg Archives gives +1 skillslot. Also unlocking the possibility to refine some skills at the Guildmasters in St.Petersburg once you reached Rank 15. Giving you a permanent +2 in that skill, some skill specific bonus and turning the skill back to Rank 1, you can then rank it up again and you need less prof to do so. Not every skill can be refined.

=======================================================================================

Getting more Port Permits Port Permit

The number listed under each Nation is the aproximated fame (total) you need to unlock that Permit, it got nerfed quite a while ago, so nowadays you need less fame.
Once you got The Indian Ocean and Caribbean Sea you progress by doing Imperial Quests.
The Permits must be unlocked from top to bottom, no skipping allowed!

Why? More Places To Sail = More Better!
Particular point of interest: Calicut in the Indian Permit, talking to the bank clerk gives +5 bank vault slots, and it is a place to get Pepper.

=======================================================================================

Join a Company

Ask in World Chat [Community->World Chat Settings->"General" or "Beginners"] if any Company is looking for new members (spoiler, there are always Companys looking for new Members ;) If you happen to not get a response, dont be discouraged, ask again later.)

Why? More Friends = More Better!
Also: access to a Company Colony, different benefits depending on what your company has decided to build.
Sending Aides to Aide Fleets to get Gift for Regional Activities (up to 1 each day), Gift for Regional Contributions (1 each month) and a lot of XP for the Aide.

=======================================================================================

Nation Story

Every Nation has a different Story, it takes a lot of time, it is a lot of text to read or to click away, but if you have fun reading then go for it.
The Rewards are basicly non existent though, you do get a unique Crest (Saint Mark's Lion Crest,Viscount of Vernier Crest,Sea Brigade Crest,Middleton Family Crest,Orca Mercenary's Crest,Sarmiento Company Crest) at the end of each Story and you have slightly lower fame requirements for permits if you got to the point in the story where you need to get to a Port that requires that permit. But it takes so long to do that you can easily get way more fame then needed by doing other stuff.
In short: Do it if you like the Story/Crest, otherwise you can ignore it without any problems

=======================================================================================

Oxford

After school is more school, who thought. Once you get to Level 5/5/5 you can start doing Oxford research.
1. Sail to London and take the Carriage to Oxford.
2. Talk to the Professor there to start research.
3. Once a research is done turn it in at any Scholar (or in Oxford) and start a new one or the same one again.
4. There is also a story, if you turn in a research and you get a message in chat telling you about Oxford, then talk to the Professor again for some story and more research options.

Every Research unlock a passive skill you can slot for a couple of different bonusses, like sailing speed, battle buffs, better trading skills, lot of very useful skills to get from there.
Take a look at the Search bar on the left side and click on "University"

=======================================================================================
=======================================================================================

$---------$
Merchant
$---------$
XP/Fame

get high value stuff from other regions like Spices or Nanban Goods
XP: sell all at once after max haggle, max profit, max xp
Fame: get a lot of Local Specialty Trade Goods from as far away as possible, sell 50 of each, for example after a trip to South East Asia, sell 50xMace + 50xCloves + 50xNutmeg

=======================================================================================

Rare Trade Goods

At any given time 10 randomly selected trade goods are considered rare and can be sold for a HIGH price! Ask the Market Keeper about "Rare Trade Goods Information" or ask in World Chat if somebody would tell you the RTGs List.


=======================================================================================

Trade Routes

Caribbean: RumTequilaTobaccoCacaoCoffeeSilverGold Dust

Company Colony: Depending on the goods a Colony has it can be better then Caribbean and sometimes even Pepper runs!

Indian Ocean: Pepper

Southeast Asia: ClovesNutmegMace

East Asia: Nanban Trade

=======================================================================================

Crafting Skills

Storage for less dura loss over time on equipment, including usable equipment like Amulet of the Sun
To make stuff like: Pet Food Feeding Pets - Beginners
Tributes Tribute Goods for Brigands Fine Tribute Goods (Large Ships)
Parts for Ship improvement Special Ship Hold

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Casting lot of different stuff including:
Cannons like Volkan (18), Ship Plating like Maestro's Rolled Iron Plating
Armour like Gold-plated Armour, Weapons like Japanese Muskets
Parts for Ship improvement Modified Heavy Gun Port

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Handicrafts lot of different stuff, some examples:
Ship Hulls (together with Shipbuilding) like Large Flush Deck Style Hull
General useful items: Deck Brush, Request Investment Book, Ceasefire Agreement
Ship Parts Sea Monster Weathered Cedar Plating
100 Defense Boots Leather Boots
Quarter Furniture Skill Bookshelf 5 Tiers
Parts for Ship Improvement Workshop
Trade Goods like: Wine and Lumber

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Cooking lots of dishes, sooooooo many dishes, some examples:
Vigour Food Seafood Pizza Salted Fish with Nuts Tuna Olive Steak
Pet Food Raising Pets - BeginnersRaising Pets - Advanced
Aide Food Multi-course Cuisine Collection - Pt 1
Parts for Ship improvement Galley

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sewing Clothes and Sails
Clothes like MittensCaribbean ShirtBora Tunic
Sails like Modified Full Rigged Sail
Parts for Ship improvement Painter Rope

=======================================================================================
=======================================================================================

?----------?
Adventure
?----------?

XP/Fame
Discover all the Ports! for XP and report them to Admiral Dias Estate for fame. Or to other NPCs https://unchartedwaters.fandom.com/wiki/People_to_Report_Discoveries

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Charting
start at Mercator Estate, xp starts slow but you get more with each chart

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanksgiving

Once a month (Monday-Thursday after Epic Sea Feud) you have 4 days of Thanksgiving, thats a good Opportunity for adventure xp. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3AOV5oSnlyU)

=======================================================================================

Sea of Wonders

The Phantom Monsters in Sea of Wonders are high level battle stuff, but with chest runs you can start right after finishing school.

How? Talk to Ibn in Alexandria
He sends you to talk to 3 NPCs (can be done in any order):
1. Artisan looking man in Tunis, by the bank
2. Young Merchant in Naples, close to the Gatekeeper
3. Middle-aged Man in Cairo, next to the item shop

4. Back to Ibn.
5. After leaving Alexandria look west for a BIG cloud, thats the Portal to Sea of Wonders
6. Activate Surveying, look for a star (exit to the next map) on the minimap, get to that star as fast as possible (no wind in Sea of Wonders, if you have Rowing use your fastest rowing ship, otherwise your fastest adventure ship, if fresh out of Sagres then Memorial Cruise Sloop or Graduation Sambuk
7. Avoid every NPC ship you see (hard battles without rewards)
8. After the third map you will get the Lighthouse of Alexandria discovery
9. Head back to Ibn, after a talk you can now use his recipes
10. Head back to Sea of Wonders, this time focus on the chests on the minimap

Why?
Paper Fragment with a Tower for Master's Tailoring Tools and a lot of other useful stuff

=======================================================================================

Legacy

The first Legacy Quest Legacy TH1. After King Khufu needs lower skills then the Advanced Adventure Exams.

Legacys are a big topic, with lots to do, see and learn. I strongly recommend Beomis informations about legacy stuff (and WAY more!) on https://tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO TAB "10. Legacy(1.Giza 2.Hali)"

=======================================================================================

Shipwrecks

You probably already got some Shipwreck Map Piece. Time to raise (and loot!) a wreck or a couple!

Get the Salvage from Athen, dont bother with salvage ropes, you want to spam Salvage without worrying abut running out of them and also you want to rank it as fast as possible. If you later decide that shipwrecks are not for you then just get rid of the skill.
Also you need Haul, if you are low on skill slots: a lot of towns in Europe sell Simple Haul Rope those work fine for the first couple of wrecks.

Talk to the "Rugged Voyager" in Sagres for a Shipwreck Trail Mission.

Here the Basics:
1. Use Shipwreck Map Pieces (or use the Trial Mission) until you have a full map. Journal->Shipwreck to see the map.
2. If you have an Aide put him/her in the Lookout job, so you get messages in chat if you are close to the right spot.
3. Get into your ship with the most sailors, bring timber for repairs.
4. Sail to the right sea zone (if you have trouble finding it use the tips on the shipwreck map pieces page here on Ivyro)
5. In the right zone spam salvage, if you are in a fleet you get the meassage which of the fleetmates is the closest to the wreck, makes it easier to find, solo you need to rely on your Aide
6. Once you got it it autoraises the wreck slowly, if you get less then 5% each time then stop raising and sail a bit forward, activate Salvage again, see if you got a better spot.
7. Once you raised it use Haul (skill or item), tow it to the nearest port, stop if you get the message that the rope is about to break.
8. Once in a port get into your land battle gear, get back to port and enter the wreck, loot all the chest, for some Chest you need Unlock
9. Fight the Bandits that might spawn once you opened some chests.

=======================================================================================

Adventure Quests chains

Lot of high level Adventure Quest Chains like XanaduThe promised future, VikingsVikings, Stargazer Bull of the Heavens. Keep those in mind for later.
BUT: Rumoured School is a chain with 20 quests, most of them need no skills at all other then Languages, which you can even ignore or if needed use Translation Notes Romance Translation Note.

=======================================================================================
=======================================================================================

x-----x
Battle
x-----x

XP/Fame

The simple answer to both is: Battle Reports, Battle Reports from Lisbon (Also there is one for each other home town)
Battle Reports from the Baltic Sea or Battle Reports from the Tyrrhenian Sea
The highest with the most xp is: Battle Reports from the Black Sea (lots of little fleets around, the formidable Enemys can be a problem, Amulet of the Sun helps wiht that, also hostile water, bring Fine Tribute Goods (Large Ships) and dont carry a lot of ducats)

How?
1. Get a Battle Report Quest, head to the right Sea Region, for example "Lisbon, Open Sea" for the Lisbon Battle Report
2. Sink ships, every ship counts so try to sink the Admiral (the ship with the little face next to the name) last.
3. Every 50 points you will get the Message that formidable enemys try to attack you, dont use Caution High Lookout or an item/pet with a similar effect (Reduce incidence of attacks Taiwan Magpie (Black) otherwise they cant attack. THey are way harder if the normal ships in that zone, beat them in a hard battle or use Taiwan Magpie (Black). You can just focus on the admiral to end those boss rounds quickly.
4. Every beaten formidable enemy round you get better rewards in the end, up to 200 points (4 battles against formidable enemys).
5. turn in the Quest, keep in mind that you can only get +3 Levels with one action (like turning in a quest, or selling trade goods), so if you got 3 levels with one Battle Report, try doing less ships next time.
6. It does not matter how you beat the ships, if you want to grind cannon skills use cannons, if you want to grind melee skills use melee, fastest way would be to use AoS (Amulet of the Sun)
7. Fleeting with some (or an Alt) with Mrt. Mentor's Wisdom 1 speeds up BRs significantly.

A XP Table for Battle Reports (use google translate)
https://w.atwiki.jp/rougenoir2/pages/159.html

=======================================================================================

Dungeons

There are 14 different Dungeons. THe first one is the Church in Syracuse.

Preperations
1. Get a weapon to bonk some dorks on the head with. LOT of options out there.
"Papaya Starter Pack Lv50" for reaching a total level of 50 (check Record->Challenge Mission) contains Tristan's Sword.
If you are not quite there yet or want a different weapon: Plymouth Item Shop sells: Guisarme

2. Get some armour:
St.Petersburg Item Shop sells Lamellar Armour and some other options if you have the Adept of Ages (18th Century-P.3) Age title. The quest you needed to do to unlock St. Petersburg Delivery Request to the capital of Russia gave you that title, you can have 2 Age titles, so unless you did 2 different Chrono Quest after that you should still have that title.
Lubeck Item Shop sells Winged Hussar's Armour and a Helmet if you have any of the 16th century Age titles.
After some Investment in Hamburg the Item Shop there sells Plate Armour (also needs battle job and Court Rank 7th Knight to equip)
